Legacy of the Ark: Beneath the Broken Sky

name: Legacy of the Ark: Beneath the Broken Sky
summary: Awaken alone at the crash site of a fallen Ark and rebuild from a single handful of scrap. Gather, wake survivors, level them up, send expeditions, chart the deep, and stabilize a broken sky in this cozy, honest idle game. Play at your pace — online or off.
